data.narrative: The student demonstrated mastery of systems integration and verification, successfully closing the loop from initial requirements extraction to final cross-component testing. They accurately diagnosed a silent semantic drift bug ('confirmed' vs 'active') that bypassed local unit tests, proving deep understanding of contract-based integration. By choosing incremental merging and scenario-based verification, they isolated failures efficiently and maintained an honest requirements traceability matrix.

dimension_scores.observation: Conducted a rigorous final traceability audit, correctly identifying that 'Advanced Search' had fallen through the cracks during vertical slicing rather than claiming 100% coverage.
Applied dependency logic to the integration phase by choosing an incremental merge order starting with foundation components (DB/Auth) before API layers.
Identified 'Big Bang' integration as an unacceptable risk when merging AI-generated code due to the impossibility of root-cause isolation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option B (Incremental) to localize failures to specific commits.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced a repeatable integration test plan that explicitly defines the setup, steps, and expected contract outcomes for critical boundaries.
Applied an immediate tactical patch to unblock a demo while simultaneously designing a strategic, schema-driven solution for the future.
dimension_scores.evidence: Patched the dashboard filter to accept 'confirmed,active' while mandating OpenAPI/Pact for systemic prevention.

dimension_scores.observation: Successfully traced a silent integration bug to a semantic mismatch between two parallel components that both passed their local acceptance criteria.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed the 'confirmed' vs 'active' mismatch without needing hints.

data.recommendation: The student has completed the curriculum with distinction. They are ready to lead multi-agent engineering teams using these decomposition and integration methodologies.

public_evidence.student_action: Executed an incremental merge strategy, performed a full requirements traceability audit, and diagnosed a semantic contract mismatch across parallel workstreams.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Traced a silent data-drop bug between an API and Frontend caused by misaligned enum values ('confirmed' vs 'active'), and proposed automated contract testing (Pact) + OpenAPI generation as the systemic fix.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the candidate can take a project from ambiguous product requirements all the way to a verified, integrated system, catching the subtle cross-boundary bugs that typically slip into production.

Merged components sequentially to isolate breaking changes.

teaching_approaches.detail: Presented a symptom without the cause to test cross-boundary tracing.
